_comment: THE CROSSING FIXTURE (authored 2026-08-30). Measured that day: no fixture in the tree contained one — the real Miyakojima dump has a 20.0 km largest gap and zero discontinuities, because the desk fixtures were built from folders hand-curated to the destination while the device import pulls the travel days (Docs/cross-region-journeys.md). Shape: a short drive across Taipei to Taoyuan airport, an unroutable crossing of open sea, then four stops on Ishigaki. Hand-written plausible coordinates of public places, like every committed fixture — never a real trip (CLAUDE.md §0).
